A '''starship''' was used by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] during his time with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. He used the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to travel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] to recruit his former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Falon Grey]], to the Rebel cause. However, he found that Grey was dead, and a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] created from Grey's genetic template was tending a [[Farm/Legends|farm]] on the surface. [[X2]], as the clone was known, joined the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="BF" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''
